title: Potassium & the ECG

findings.where: Inline and step 'worked': potassium.jsx match outline; kit.jsx Gauge valueBad/pinFill; generated cases k=3.49 and k=5.01
findings.title: Every abnormal result receives critical styling
findings.problem: The marker and matched-strip outline become coral for any out-of-range value. Thus 3.49 and 5.01 receive the same critical-color treatment as severe abnormalities, although neither value is intrinsically critical. This conflates abnormal classification with critical status under the specified color meanings.
findings.fix: Use neutral category outlines and amber for caution-level abnormalities. Reserve coral for scenarios identified as critical; do not derive critical styling solely from being outside 3.5–5.0.

assessment: No substantiated clinical or ECG-shape blocker found. The generated borderline cases violate the project's critical-color rule.
